spec_match.rationale: Measures the spec's own §10.5 equivalence example — color(display-p3 0.591 0.123 0.264) vs color(display-p3-linear 0.3081 0.014 0.0567) — by painting both through canvas fillStyle and diffing getImageData bytes, with a byte-level pass bound.

interactive.rationale: A run button paints four declarations for real and fills the results table with the landed bytes and a per-pair max-difference verdict.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card says 'prove it with pixels' and the page does exactly that, including on the always-available srgb-linear pair.

edge_cases.rationale: Documents and handles the silent-ignore failure mode of invalid fillStyle with a sentinel-colour detection (explicitly contrasted with the enum TypeError on the v155 canvas feature), and reports 'parse rejected — sentinel fillStyle survived' rather than misreading stale bytes.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5162372125818880, §10.5, and the v155 canvas feature it bridges to.

conformance.rationale: Suite assertion spec-example-pair-paints-identically is this page's contract verbatim (same sentinel technique, ≤1 byte bound); suite verified executing on /conformance/.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable here): autorun DOM shows both display-p3-linear/one pair row rejected honestly, while the srgb pair measures 'max byte difference 0 — SAME colour within rounding'; screenshots at 1280 and 360 read; CDP clean console, no overflow.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts pixel-proof-p3l-parses or the explicit fallback on load, and per-pair pixel-pair-*-equal assertions that would fail telemetry if a supporting browser ever painted the pair differently.

design_system.rationale: Token chrome, captioned table, AA verdict text, dark button with both background and color set.

accessibility.rationale: Single clearly-labelled action button, results as a semantic captioned table, aria-live summary, statuses as words (painted/unsupported), role=status support banner.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Table scrolls in its own wrapper; CDP-measured no horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3; both class screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Record the measured P3-pair bytes from a Chrome 144+ browser
openQuestions.detail: On this Chromium 141 the P3 pair is honestly 'not measurable' (declarations rejected). On 144+, run the proof and record the actual byte diff — the conformance assertion expects ≤1; if a real build ever exceeds that, flag the browser, not the assertion.

guidanceConsulted.query: feature detect css color parsing canvas fillStyle silent failure
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: modern-web-guidance has no fillStyle-specific guide; general guidance requires detection that can actually return false and honest degraded states.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Exception recorded: no direct guide. Applied the principle with a sentinel-based detector (invalid fillStyle is silently ignored, so try/catch cannot work), which is demonstrated in the page's own technique section.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce post-interaction results through live regions and keep tables semantic.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The verdict summary is an aria-live output and results render into a captioned table with scoped headers.

summary: Novel-composition concept: verifies the spec's equivalence claim with actual painted pixels via the canvas fillStyle bridge, using sentinel-based rejection detection. The srgb-linear pair passes with byte-diff 0 on Chromium 141; the P3 pair reports honest non-measurability pre-144. Verified at both device classes with clean console.
